parameters.help_en: The ID of the intelligent production job that you want to query. You can obtain the job ID from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170216.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的智能生产作业ID。从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170216.html的返回参数中获取
parameters.name: job_id

FunctionName.description_en:
The algorithm name. Valid values:

VideoH2V: intelligent landscape-to-portrait.

VideoDelogo: video logo removal.

Cover: intelligent cover.

VideoClip: video synopsis.

ImageH2V: landscape-to-portrait.

ImageDelogo: image logo removal.

CaptionExtraction: caption extraction.

VideoDetext: video caption removal.

VideoGreenScreenMatting: image matting.

MusicSegmentDetect: chorus detection.

AudioMixing: audio mixing.

AudioBeatDetection: beat detection.

ImageCartoonize: 3D style and face stylization. To use the face stylization feature, contact the DingTalk account yuanzhigao1209.

AudioQualityAssessment: audio quality assessment.

Audio quality assessment supports 16-bit quantized WAV audio files with mono or stereo channels and a sampling rate range of 8000 to 48000 Hz
FunctionName.description_zh:
算法名称。取值：

VideoH2V：视频横转竖。

VideoDelogo：视频去图标。

Cover：智能封面。

VideoClip：视频摘要。

ImageH2V：横转竖。

ImageDelogo：图片去图标。

CaptionExtraction：字幕提取。

VideoDetext：视频去字幕。

VideoGreenScreenMatting：绿幕抠图。

MusicSegmentDetect：副歌检测。

AudioMixing：混音处理。

AudioBeatDetection：节奏检测。

ImageCartoonize：3D风格、人脸风格化（需使用人脸风格化的功能请联系钉钉号：yuanzhigao1209对接）。

AudioQualityAssessment：音质检测。

音质检测输入音频支持16bit量化的WAV音频文件，支持单双声道，支持的采样率范围为8000~48000Hz

Input.description_en: The OSS bucket of the input file

Output.description_en: The OSS bucket of the output file

Result.description_en: The detailed information about the job result. For more information, see [Supplementary description of intelligent production operation parameters]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/352026.html）
Result.description_zh: 作业结果详细信息。更多信息请参见[智能生产接口参数补充说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/352026.html）

State.description_en:
The job status. Valid values:

Queuing: The job is queued.

Analysing: The job is being analyzed.

Fail: The job failed.

Success: The job succeeded
State.description_zh:
作业状态。取值：

Queuing：排队中。

Analysing：分析中。

Fail：失败。

Success：成功
